taxonomy.reason: The pinned HUMSET pilot has not been evaluated. Existing authored controls remain a separate benchmark.
taxonomy.methodology: Target 16 development and 64 held-out historical excerpts, deterministic selection with document/lead separation. Report actual language counts, rejected outputs, micro/macro F1 and denominators after independent review. No quantity or location gold is inferred.

retrieval.reason: Independent query judgments and the measured E5 comparison are pending.
retrieval.methodology: Compare lexical and E5 ranking on the same bounded corpus with at least 30 independently annotated English/Spanish queries, relevant passages and hard negatives. Publish Recall@5, Precision@3 and MRR only with reviewed counts and source-link checks.

transcription.reason: Rights-reviewed audio and independent reference transcripts have not been supplied.
transcription.methodology: Use permitted mono 16 kHz audio, original-language timestamped transcription and offline reference scoring. Measure WER, latency, critical-field errors and silence behavior; no reference transcript enters inference.

storage.purpose: Retrieve finalized numeric simulation packs across machines and verify their bytes.
storage.holds: Typed configuration, seed, numeric snapshots, allowlisted aggregates and integrity manifest.
storage.excludes: Raw reports, audio/transcripts, names, sensitive locations, secrets, datasets and model weights.
